metadata.title: Reserve-balanced affine local moment
metadata.description: Reallocates intermediate LOW and extracted-error reserves to enlarge the affine local-moment defect allowance to 1/250 while retaining the amplifier, volume cap, and final analytic savings. Regenerates the endpoint and transport arithmetic for the canonical all-Dirichlet statement. Builds on Kari Roegnvaldsson's affine-capacity proof, nielstron's local 22/5 moment, Zhongpai Gao's local-moment work, Hailey Collet's Cycle25 framework, Akash Levy's weighted numerator, and OpenAI/math. Prepared with AI assistance.

The affine local moment retains more intermediate saving than its final assembly consumes. This candidate raises the allowed defect from `37/10000` to `1/250`, retaining amplifier `3/500`, source-volume cap `881/1000`, and all final analytic saving powers. The raw LOW reserve becomes `1/22500`, its retained half `1/45000`, and the extracted-error reserve `1/1200`. After the existing eleven tiny fees, the LOW saving still exceeds `1/50000`; the extracted-error assembly retains its existing `1/2000`, `1/2500`, and final `1/10000` targets.

The wider capacity is `(251/250-2n)/(9/2)`. The existing physical window and transport repayment remain valid. Regenerated exact endpoint polynomials and the conservative transport certificate use `theta=87486797/100000000`, `ell=12539609/75000000`, and unchanged `h=397/500`.

**Draft verification status:** complete candidate source is provided; its integrated canonical theorem and admission remain pending. Pinned Lean 4.34.1 and Mathlib `d13f23b` checked 15 capacity/reserve lemmas, the actual downstream reserve consumers, complete physical capacity/diagonal dispatch modules, the complete endpoint arithmetic, and the regenerated transport arithmetic. Printed axioms are only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`. The submission shape passes the standard manifest validator, with unchanged imports and no new axiom or opaque declarations. These local checks do not replace full Comparator/Lean/NanoDa/con-ron verification.

The predecessor at commit `c707738` passed all kernels and admission in [run 38393872414](https://github.com/GTimG/QuasiRiemannTracker/actions/runs/38393872414). This PR preserves that source in #37 and submits the further candidate separately. Existing admitted submissions are untouched; original source notices are retained. Section hashes identify inherited pre-adaptation modules.
